You will own the end-to-end early customer experience across web and app — spanning post-checkout confirmation, subscription management, digital engagement, and the critical Box 1→2→3 progression — across all HelloFresh Group brands, including Factor. The defining product challenge ahead is building and scaling the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: an ML-powered, segment-aware system that identifies the right action for each customer at each moment in their early lifecycle and delivers it seamlessly across web and app surfaces. This is a genuine 0-to-1 build — one that requires both strategic vision and hands-on execution. This role demands a PM who is obsessed with solving customer pain points and equally obsessed with the cross-squad collaboration required to do it at scale. Onboarding does not sit inside a single product surface — it spans the activation funnel, CRM and lifecycle communications, app and engagement experiences, and Data Science. The PM leading this squad must be a hyper-collaborator: capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across squads and tribes and bringing coherence to an experience that crosses many surfaces and teams. What you'll do • Own the product vision and strategy for the end-to-end Onboarding experience across all HelloFresh Group brands — from post-checkout confirmation to Settled Conversion (3 boxes in 4 weeks). • Lead the build and scaling of the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: a segment-aware, state-aware personalisation system that dynamically surfaces the right customer action at the right moment across web and app. • Drive measurable improvement in Settled Conversion rate through a high-velocity experimentation roadmap. • Own the full-surface onboarding experience — welcome dashboard, subscription management, meal selection flows, app onboarding layer, and CRM-triggered touchpoints — ensuring coherence and quality across every channel and surface. • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to define the data and ML foundations that power personalised, segment-aware onboarding at scale. • Act as the connective tissue between squads and tribes: align the Activation funnel squad, CRM and Communications tribe, and App and Engagement team around a unified onboarding strategy and shared north-star metrics. • Build deep consumer empathy through qualitative research, quantitative funnel analysis, and direct customer engagement — and bring the early customer voice into every product decision. • Define and own success metrics for Onboarding — Settled Conversion rate, Box 1→2 and 2→3 conversion, app adoption rate, and unwanted box rate — and hold yourself and the squad accountable to them. • Own BAU operations: triage funnel issues rapidly, maintain onboarding health monitoring, and serve as the escalation point for anything threatening early retention performance. • Drive cross-functional alignment as a single-threaded leader across global tribes and alliances — creating clarity and shared direction needed for the squad to ship at velocity. What you'll bring • Customer Lifecycle & Early Retention Expertise: A deep understanding of subscription customer lifecycle dynamics — churn triggers, early retention levers, and the interplay between product experience and commercial outcomes. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Templates & Hierarchy
jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. We're growing fast and hiring the Product talent to match. We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to join our Core Division. This role sits in the Enterprise Knowledge pillar, the team responsible for how large, multi-site customers define and govern their operational data. The pillar is building the Templating Service: the layer that lets an enterprise define a procedure, asset, work order or part once and cascade it to every site, with versioning, update policies and controlled publishing. What You'll Do You'll own the Templating Service end to end, and as it matures, the redesign of the location and asset hierarchy underneath it. • Own strategy, roadmap and execution for templates across assets, procedures, work orders and parts, taking the current design-partner alpha to GA adoption across multi-site enterprise accounts • Consolidate three overlapping configuration systems into one registry, with a migration path and deprecation sequence that strands no customer mid-move • Resolve the semantics this space is full of — update policies, publish and conflict flows, versioning, promoting existing records into templates — so teams building on top have settled rules • Run the design-partner program yourself: recurring customer sessions and prototype-driven discovery, converted into roadmap • Take the hierarchy redesign from spec to validated model — typed locations, N-level depth, functional positions that keep PM schedules alive through asset swaps — additive and non-breaking for customers on today's two-level structure About You • 10+ years in product management, including 5+ years of platform or core-product work at an enterprise SaaS company — entity models, permissioning, configuration frameworks, the foundations other products are built on, not the features on top • Deep systems thinking: you can hold a cascade/override policy or a hierarchy schema in your head, reason about cardinality and migration states, and argue the trade-offs with staff engineers as a peer • A real discovery motion — you run design-partner sessions yourself and let evidence overrule opinion • A track record sequencing multi-year foundational work while shipping customer-visible value every quarter Nice To Have • CMMS, EAM or industrial operations background • Experience migrating customers off SAP PM or Maximo-class systems Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hoo
